title: Leaf Strainers 6-Pack – Stops the Leaves at the Downspout Opening
seo_title: Leaf Strainers 6-Pack – Stainless Steel Mesh for Downspouts
seo_description: 6 leaf strainers in stainless steel mesh that are shaped into a cone and placed in the mouth of the downspout. The leaves stay on the outside instead of clogging the pipe.
descriptionHtml:
The leaves find their way down into the downspout opening

Every fall, leaves collect in the gutter and slide on down into the downspout opening before you get around to cleaning. A clog builds up quietly, long before you see that anything is wrong.

A mesh that stops the leaves at the opening

Six strainers in stainless steel mesh are shaped into a cone and placed in the mouth of the downspout. The leaves stay on the outside of the mesh instead of going down the pipe.

Features

  • 6 strainers in the pack – enough for several downspouts around the house at once.
  • Stainless steel mesh – a material made to sit outside in rain and leaves, season after season.
  • Shaped into a cone – the strainer goes straight into the downspout opening, no screw or knife needed.
  • The leaves stay on the outside of the mesh – not inside the pipe where they are hard to reach.

The lifestyle images are AI-generated illustrations.

No information on the diameter of the opening – we can't guarantee fit on unusually narrow or wide downspouts.

14 days to change your mind – if you don't like it, you get your money back. Tracked delivery and secure checkout. 🦫
